remarks: Beautifully Remodeled 4-Bedroom Home in the Cleveland Hill School District! Welcome to 15 Allendale Rd, a beautifully remodeled home that blends classic charm with majority modern 2026 updates! Offering 4 bedrooms, 1.5 bathrooms, and stylish upgrades throughout, this move-in-ready property delivers comfort, functionality, and space to enjoy. Step inside to discover brand-new flooring throughout the entire home, freshly painted interiors, and an updated living room featuring brand-new electrical lighting and modern fixtures. The eat-in kitchen has been refreshed with new flooring, updated countertops, a luxury sink, and fresh paint, creating an inviting space for everyday living and entertaining. The thoughtfully designed layout features two generously sized bedrooms on the first floor and two additional bedrooms upstairs that have been freshly painted with brand new flooring and updated electrical fixtures. A beautifully renovated full bathroom with luxury finishes is conveniently located on the first floor, while an updated modern half bathroom serves the second floor. Exterior improvements include newly installed vinyl windows in 2026, durable vinyl siding, and a freshly painted front porch. Enjoy your morning coffee or unwind in the evening on the spacious front porch, or take advantage of the large backyard—perfect for outdoor gatherings, entertaining, and enjoying warmer weather. The landscaping has also been enhanced with the removal of several trees, helping open up the outdoor space. Additional features include a spacious basement with a sump pump, a newer hot water tank, forced-air heating throughout, and an attached storage area for added convenience. As an added bonus, the pool table in the basement will stay with the home! If you’re looking for a home with modern updates, a flexible four-bedroom layout, inviting outdoor space, and a desirable Cleveland Hill School District location, this beautifully refreshed property is one to see.
